name: Keto Turkey and Green Bean Casserole
mapped_note: turkey->turkey-breast, cooked green beans->fresh-green-beans/canned-green-beans, shredded cheddar->cheddar-cheese-shredded, mayonnaise->mayonnaise, garlic->garlic, walnuts->walnuts
why: Baked keto turkey + green-bean casserole; published 416 cal / 12.5g total carb (9g net) / 23.6g protein per serving at 8 servings clears the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band on the source's own numbers. Cheese/mayo-bound, no rice/pasta/potato/bread base, so structurally low-carb. Fills a real gap: no turkey green-bean bake exists in the 544-recipe catalog (closest is broccoli/zucchini turkey bakes, all distinct). Deliberately carries TWO genuinely board-absent ingredients (cranberry sauce, goat cheese) which is a FEATURE for the pricer-lane proving run.
confidence_notes: Verified: read the page's own nutrition. Two caveats for the selector: (1) sits near the 400 floor and protein 23.6g is just under the catalog's 25g ideal, so it has little headroom on a low-side recompute; (2) the low published carb depends on a SUGAR-FREE cranberry sauce (WholesomeYum is a keto site) - if the board maps cranberry sauce to a full-sugar row, our computed carbs could rise materially. Turkey mapped to turkey-breast (cooked/leftover); a diced-chicken-style whole-muscle turkey, not ground.
